caption: RefineryLens: independent business intelligence on opportunities around Dangote
say: This is RefineryLens: independent business intelligence on the opportunities around Dangote, for businesses of every size.

caption: Every figure carries its source, period and provenance label
say: Every figure carries its source, its period, and a label saying where it came from. Missing data is shown as missing.

caption: Sign in with a demo account (investor, Pro plan)
say: Let's sign in with the demo investor account.

caption: The business opportunities hub: 14 ways to plug into the Lekki complex
say: The opportunities hub maps fourteen ways for a business to plug into the Lekki complex, from fuel retail and haulage to plastics, aviation fuel and plant services.

caption: Filter by business size, from micro to enterprise
say: You can filter by business size.

caption: Only opportunities a micro business can realistically pursue remain
say: Choosing micro leaves only the opportunities a very small business can realistically pursue.

caption: Find my fit: describe your business, get ranked matches
say: Find my fit asks three quick questions: your size, your interests, and the assets you already have.

caption: Each match explains why it is listed, including assets you already have
say: The matches are ranked, and each one explains why it's listed. Here, the tanker trucks we already own count in our favour.

caption: An opportunity page: LPG cylinder refilling and retail
say: Let's open LPG cylinder refilling and retail.

caption: Company-stated facts, dated independent reports, questions and licences to check
say: Each opportunity shows the company-stated facts it rests on, dated independent reports that help or hurt the case, and the licences you'd need to check.

caption: Readiness checklist: tick off what you have already answered
say: The readiness checklist tracks the questions you've already answered.

caption: The sizing tool: enter your own numbers, or start from labelled examples
say: The sizing tool takes your own numbers, or you can start from clearly labelled examples.

caption: Formulas stay visible, so every result can be checked
say: The formulas stay visible, so every result can be checked by hand.

caption: What-if table: each key input moved ±10% to show what matters most
say: The what-if table moves each key input up and down by ten percent, so you can see which assumption matters most.

caption: Save a private scenario and track the opportunity on your board
say: Save the scenario privately, and add the opportunity to your board with a stage and a next step.

caption: Download a one-page PDF brief with sources, readiness answers and the scenario
say: And download a one-page PDF brief, with the sources, your readiness answers, and your scenario.

caption: My opportunity board: stage, next step, readiness progress and saved scenarios
say: Your board brings it together: stage, next step, readiness progress and saved scenarios.

caption: Behind it: the evidence-first research layer (shown here on a fictional demo company)
say: Behind all this sits the evidence-first research layer, shown here on a clearly labelled fictional demo company.

caption: Sourced metrics, what changed, conflicts kept visible
say: It tracks what changed, with sourced metrics, and when sources disagree, the conflict stays visible.

caption: The research assistant answers only from cited evidence
say: The research assistant answers only from cited evidence.

caption: A direct answer, with every claim linked to its source
say: You get a direct answer, with every claim linked back to its source.

caption: Market and macro context, labelled as non-company data, with honest gaps
say: Market and macro context is labelled as non-company data, and gaps are shown honestly.

caption: RefineryLens: find the opportunity, examine the evidence, size it with your own numbers
say: RefineryLens. Find the opportunity, examine the evidence, and size it with your own numbers.
